answers.brief_reasoning: HNO3 dissociates completely, so [H+] = 0.02 M and pH = -log(0.02) = 1.70
Each Ba(OH)2 gives 2 OH-, so [OH-] = 0.050 M, pOH = 1.30 and pH = 14 - 1.30 = 12.70
mol H+ = 0.025 L x 0.02 M = 5.0e-4 mol. Each Ba(OH)2 supplies 2 OH-, so 2.5e-4 mol Ba(OH)2 is needed. Volume = 2.5e-4 mol / 0.025 M = 0.010 L = 10 mL
A strong acid and a strong base react completely to give water and Ba(NO3)2. Neither Ba2+ nor NO3- hydrolyzes, so [H+] = [OH-] = 1e-7 M at 25 °C
